title: Admin
subtitle: Founding cohort, plans and referrals. Until Stripe webhooks are live, payments are recorded here by hand.

stats.foundersHint: The first {cap} paying agents, in order

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: "Paid invoice" does what the Stripe webhook will do: marks them subscribed and counts the invoice towards their referrer's reward. "Comp" gives Pro time from the backend, no card involved.

referrals.title: Referrals
referrals.description: Qualifies at the referred agent's second paid invoice; both sides then get a free month.

credits.title: Free months
credits.description: Balance credits are pushed to Stripe once the agent has a Stripe customer. Comped Pro time is applied the moment it is granted.
